Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
We’re looking for a Full Stack .NET / Angular Developer with 7+ years of experience to join our team and contribute to the development of modern trading applications.
 What you’ll do: 
 · Design, develop, and enhance full-stack applications using .NET Core and Angular.
 · Integrate and adapt applications within an existing technical ecosystem.
 · Manage technical debt and ensure alignment with architecture and information security guidelines.
 · Implement automated testing and monitoring to ensure reliable operations.
 · Collaborate with Business Analysts, Architects, and QA teams.
 · Participate in code reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions.
 What we’re looking for: 
 · 7+ years of experience in full stack development.
 · Strong expertise in C#, .NET Core, Angular, and REST APIs.
 · Proficiency in SQL, including SQL Server and Oracle.
 · Experience with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps and Jenkins.
 · Good understanding of software architecture principles.
 · English proficiency at B2 level or above.
 · An interest in financial markets and trading solutions.
 AQUASoft is an equal opportunity employer. We invest in people, and we make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, skills, and business needs.
